payload.reason: The evidence specifies the use of two deep neural network models for evaluation in the context of Image Captioning: the Neural Image Captioning (NIC) model and an Image Captioning model from a Pytorch tutorial.

claims.text: The evaluation uses the Neural Image Captioning (NIC) model and a Pytorch tutorial Image Captioning model.
The models utilize an encoder-decoder architecture with CNN for feature extraction and RNN-LSTM for decoding.
